Rafael Ortiz, email is rafael.ortiz@mailbox.example. Order number is 6201.

events.text:
Thanks, Rafael. You're verified, and I have order K-6201 from Taqueria Luz, which was delivered at 12:24 PM today. You're within the window to report missing or wrong items.

Here's what the order included:
- Carne asada tacos ×6
- Chicken tacos ×6
- Veggie burrito ×2
- Chips and guacamole ×3
- Elote ×4
- Horchata ×4
- Cheese quesadilla ×2
- Churros ×2

One thing to know first: the restaurant marked **2 of the 4 Horchatas** as unavailable before pickup. You were automatically refunded $8.00 for those to your Visa ending 4242. If you're 2 Horchatas short, that's already been refunded.

Please tell me:
1. **Which items were missing or wrong, and how many of each?** For example, "2 chicken tacos missing, 1 burrito was wrong."
2. **How would you like to be compensated?** You can choose either:
   - a **refund to your card**, or
   - **Forkful account credit** worth the item's price plus 20%.

   Because the order used the promo code OFFICE16, a card refund works a bit differently. You'd get the item's price minus its share of the discount back on your card. That share of the discount comes back to you as account credit. I'll show you the exact amounts once I know which items were affected.

Ok so carne asada tacos are short, I got 4 of the 6. Veggie burrito is also short, only got 1 of the 2.

Also the horchatas: only 2 of the 4 came. The $8 back is good, I guess, but I still paid for 4.

Need the rest of the stuff checked. Want everything refunded to the card, not credit.

I've refunded the missing items to your Visa ending 4242. Here's the breakdown.

The OFFICE16 promo took $16 (10%) off your $160 order. Most of each missing item's price goes back to your card, and its 10% share of the promo comes back as account credit:

| Item | Price | Back to card | Promo share as credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Carne asada tacos ×2 | $9.00 | $8.10 | $0.90 |
| Veggie burrito ×1 | $12.00 | $10.80 | $1.20 |
| **Total** | **$21.00** | **$18.90** | **$2.10** |

- **$18.90** is on its way to your card and should show up in 3–5 business days.
- **$2.10** is now in your Forkful account as credit for a future order.

**Horchatas:** You were charged for 4, but the restaurant didn't have 2 of them, so they refunded those 2 ($8.00) to your card right away. That means you've only paid for the 2 that arrived, and nothing more is owed for them.

**Your bank statement:** You might see two lines for $170.99. One is a temporary hold from when you placed the order. It's been cancelled and should drop off in 1–3 business days. You were only charged once.

**Other items:** I can't see what arrived in your bag, so please check the chicken tacos, chips and guac, elote, quesadillas and churros. If anything else is missing or wrong, let me know what and how many, and I'll take care of it the same way.

Ok, I checked the rest. Chicken tacos all 6, elote all 4, both churros are there. But the cheese quesadillas, one of them is chicken, not cheese. Nobody ate it, so I want that one refunded too. And chips and guac, only 2 of the 3 came.

Also the promo thing, I don't really know how much OFFICE16 took off. Is it still coming out right? Refunds to card for all of it please, not credit. The $2.10 credit isn't what I want.

Thanks for checking. I've refunded the wrong quesadilla and the missing chips and guac to your card the same way as before.

**What OFFICE16 took off:** $16.00 off your $160.00 subtotal, which is exactly 10%. You didn't pay full price for any item; you paid 10% less. So each refund goes back on the same terms:
- **90% of the item's price goes to your card.** That's the part your card actually paid for.
- **10% comes back as account credit.** That's the discount part, which the promo covered.

I can't put that 10% on your card, because your card was never charged it. I know you'd prefer it all on your card, and I'm sorry I can't do that. The credit is the discount coming back to you, and you can use it on your next order.

**Everything refunded for this order:**

| Item | Price | Back to card | Promo share as credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Carne asada tacos ×2 (missing) | $9.00 | $8.10 | $0.90 |
| Veggie burrito ×1 (missing) | $12.00 | $10.80 | $1.20 |
| Cheese quesadilla ×1 (wrong item) | $10.00 | $9.00 | $1.00 |
| Chips and guacamole ×1 (missing) | $7.00 | $6.30 | $0.70 |
| **Total** | **$38.00** | **$34.20** | **$3.80** |

- **$34.20** is going back to your Visa ending 4242 and should arrive in 3–5 business days.
- **$3.80** is now in your Forkful account as credit for your next order.
- **Horchatas:** you already got $8.00 back for the 2 that weren't available, so you've only paid for the 2 that came.

Sorry again your team lunch arrived short. Is there anything else I can help with?

Ok, so the $3.80 is still going to credit and not the card. I'm not thrilled about that, but I get that the promo was taken off the total and it doesn't work like a full refund to the card. I'll take it.

Can you confirm the $34.20 is definitely going back to the Visa ending 4242? I don't want to find out in a week it went somewhere else.

Also, just to be clear on the horchatas: I'm still short two of them, so I'm pretty annoyed about that, but the $8 back is what it is.

Thanks for sorting the rest out.

Yes, I can confirm that. All four refunds went to your **Visa ending 4242**, the card you paid with:

| Refund ID | Item | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| RF-4000 | Carne asada tacos ×2 | $8.10 |
| RF-4001 | Veggie burrito ×1 | $10.80 |
| RF-4002 | Cheese quesadilla ×1 | $9.00 |
| RF-4003 | Chips and guacamole ×1 | $6.30 |
| | **Total** | **$34.20** |

They should arrive in 3–5 business days. They may show up as four separate lines rather than one, so look for the amounts above. If anything hasn't arrived by then, contact us with these refund IDs and we can track them down.

I understand being annoyed about the horchatas. Taqueria Luz didn't have 2 of them when they made your order, so they were refunded instead of sent. The $8.00 went back to the same Visa right away. You're only paying for the 2 that came, but that doesn't make up for your team missing out, and I'm sorry.

Your $3.80 credit is in your Forkful account and will be there for your next order. Thanks for your patience, Rafael, and I hope the rest of lunch went well!

Ok, thanks. Got the refund IDs, I'll watch for those four lines on the statement.

Yeah the horchata thing is still annoying but I get it, nothing you can do about it now. Appreciate you sorting the rest out.

You're welcome, Rafael. Thanks for checking everything so carefully and being patient while we sorted it out. Sorry again about the horchatas.

If any of those four refunds hasn't shown up within 5 business days, reach out with the refund IDs and we'll look into it. Enjoy the rest of your evening!
